argv: Map, walk screen and motion polish
ops.body: - [loop] (low) The stone note pin reads late beside the coloured pins: the one neutral disc among Earth and ink's kinds looks muted for a moment before its pencil glyph says "note" (map-palette UI review U1, Nov 17, opinion; pictures `palette-02-card-390`, `palette-01-walk-390`). The owner, Nov 17: "Ship as picked, file them". To try: `COLORS.text` one step darker, its white glyph 5.5:1 or more (4.62 now), its warmth kept; fresh pictures of the card and the walk at 390 and 320, and `map/palette.test.ts` MP6 (the colour-blind floor against umber and charcoal) and MP7 (the accent's distance) measured again (decision 0188).

argv: Map, walk screen and motion polish
ops.body: - [loop] (low) With deuteranopia and protanopia the photo and video discs are two near-identical dark discs, told apart only by their 12 px glyphs (map-palette UI review U3, Nov 17, opinion; WCAG 1.4.1 met by the glyph; sims of `palette-02-card-390` and `palette-03-card-320`). The owner, Nov 17: "Ship as picked, file them". To try: widen their lightness gap, verdigris (`COLORS.photo`, glyph 6.52:1) a step lighter; fresh pictures with their sims, and MP6 and MP7 measured again (decision 0188).

argv: Map, walk screen and motion polish
ops.body: - [loop] (low) On the replay's path beat the walked ink ahead of the walker, from the navy dot to the bullseye, can read as a route still to walk, since Navigate draws its route in blue `#2563eb` (map-palette UI review U4, Nov 17, inference under NN/g H4; pictures `palette-06`, `palette-07`; ink and route blue are 12.4 apart in normal vision, never on one map). The owner, Nov 17: "Ship as picked, file them". To try: hold the ink against `COLORS.route` as a measured pair in `map/palette.test.ts` at the normal-vision floor (15), and if it fails turn the ink further toward violet within MP6 and MP7; fresh pictures of the path beat (decision 0188).
The palette's decision is 0188 (main took 0187 for the empty walk); the intro above and T22's removal say 0187.
